_schema.description: Manual merger-arb deal entries. Merged with SEC-mined deals in generate-arb-deal-board.cjs; manual entries take precedence on conflicts (same targetSymbol).

fields.acquirerSymbol: Acquirer ticker, required for stock/collar deals (used for implied-value math).
fields.addedAt: ISO date the entry was added (required).
fields.considerationType: One of: cash | stock | collar | mixed (required).
fields.exchangeRatio: Acquirer shares per target share (stock/collar deals).
fields.expectedCloseDate: Expected closing date, YYYY-MM-DD (required for annualization; use quarter-end for 'Qn YYYY' guidance).
fields.offerPricePerShare: Cash consideration per target share in USD (cash/mixed deals).
fields.target: Target company ticker symbol (required). Used for the Yahoo price fetch.
fields.thesis: Why this deal is on the board (required).

notes: confidence is set to MANUAL by the board generator; manual entries are tradeable if terms and prices resolve.
Short-sale borrow data is unavailable: stock deals always carry shortRequired=true, borrowData='unavailable'.
A verdict of 'THIN — no romance' is applied when annualizedSpreadPct < 8%.

Timeline conventions for expectedCloseDate: 'Qn YYYY' -> quarter-end; 'H1/H2 YYYY' -> Jun 30 / Dec 31; 'by (calendar) year-end YYYY' -> Dec 31; 'late YYYY or early YYYY+1' -> Mar 31 YYYY+1 (conservative: a later date understates the annualized spread). Always quote the source language in the thesis.

deals.thesis: Copart acquiring ACV Auctions at $10.50/share cash via tender offer (8-K filed Sept 10, 2026, ~$1.9B implied equity value). The 8-K body carries no quarter-level close guidance; the joint press release (Ex. 99.1) states the transaction 'is expected to close by calendar year-end 2026' — timeline added manually (miner gap: guidance lived in the exhibit, which the miner only fetches when 8-K body terms are missing). Gross spread ~0.7%.

Intercontinental Exchange acquiring MarketAxess at $167/share cash (8-K filed July 30, 2026, ~$6.0B equity value). The 8-K body carries no close-date guidance; ICE's debt-offering prospectus and press materials state the transaction 'is expected to close in the first half of 2027' — timeline added manually. Shareholder vote scheduled Oct 29, 2026; HSR waiting period refiled Sept 29, 2026. Gross spread ~1.9%.

Paramount Skydance acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery (Feb 27, 2026 merger agreement, ~$110B). Consideration is $31.00 cash plus a $0.00277778/share/day ticking fee for each day after Sept 30 through closing; the companies' Sept 30, 2026 PR announced an anticipated close of Oct 6, 2026 (subject to customary closing conditions; state-AG settlement approved, removing the final legal hurdle). Offer price set to the Oct-6 ticking-fee value $31.01666668 — this understates consideration if close slips (conservative). Timeline and ticking-fee terms added manually. Very short fuse: re-check before any use.

Merck KGaA acquiring Bio-Techne at $73/share cash (announced June 2026, ~$11.3B enterprise value). Company guidance is 'expected to close by late 2026 or early 2027' (Merck press release; repeated in Bio-Techne's FY2026 10-K) — no quarter-level date exists, so using end of Q1 2027 as the conservative endpoint per the timeline conventions (a later date understates the annualized spread). Timeline added manually. Gross spread ~0.7%.

Fox acquiring Roku: $96 cash PLUS 0.9693 FOX Class A shares per Roku share (June 14, 2026 agreement, ~$22-23B). CORRECTED vs the mined entry: the miner resolved the acquirer to FOX (Class B, ~$56); the merger agreement specifies Class A shares, so implied value and spread are recomputed on FOXA (~$62.65) — the mined 'NEGATIVE' verdict was an artifact of the wrong share class. Companies still guide close in H1 calendar 2027 despite the DOJ second request (Sept 8, 2026); S-4 effective Sept 1, 2026. Stock leg requires shorting FOXA; borrow data unavailable. Timeline added manually.

deals.thesis: Madison Dearborn Partners acquiring Marygold Companies at $2.00/share cash (announced Sept 25, 2026). Company guides close in H1 2027 — using Jun 30 per timeline conventions (conservative: later date understates annualized spread). De-riskers: holders of ~75% of voting power delivered written consent (shareholder vote effectively done), unanimous board. Risks: fund-management change-of-control / regulatory consents; 5-cent absolute spread demands limit-order discipline (slippage eats it); small-cap liquidity. Source: 2026-10-01 research hunt.

deals.thesis: Thoma Bravo acquiring Accelerant Holdings at $20.25/share cash (announced Aug 13, 2026). Company guides close in H1 2027 — using Jun 30 per timeline conventions. De-riskers: Altamont Capital (82% voting) committed; no financing condition; 6% annualized ticking fee if regulatory delays push close (delay compensates). Risks: state insurance-commissioner approvals are the real overhang (insurance deals always carry this tail); outside-date extensions possible. Source: 2026-10-01 research hunt.
